answer: Escrow bond plus a referral mirror. Each agent locks a $40 bond; the referral graph is a public mirror, so a star cluster pointing at one sponsor shows. Bonds are priced like saffron, too dear in bulk. A random beacon audits 5% each epoch: a fake loses its bond and its sponsor is slashed too. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 against a $3,000 pool. An honest agent pays $40 once, keeps its full share, and is refunded after 20 clean epochs.
